#MCP #AI #buildinpublic

Signal of the week: contributor-diversity gini coefficient.

Startups in our dataset that raised >$1M had 0.34 gini at month -3 vs 0.61 for non-raisers.

Fewer single-bus-factor projects close rounds.

Full data: signals.gitdealflow.com/research

#VC #OpenSource #DataScience

Star count alone is a vanity signal.

What actually correlates with funded rounds: stars-to-issues ratio, contributor retention at 90d, README-update cadence.

We ran the regression on 12k repos.

Dataset: signals.gitdealflow.com/data
